clues.text: This indoor ride features a modest height of 40 ft, reaches top speeds of 33 mph, and contains 0 inversions.
Designed and constructed by Swiss manufacturer Intamin, this roller coaster first opened to park guests in 1996.
Located at a major theme park in New Jersey, this ride's enclosed nature allows it to keep running even during light thunderstorms.
To keep waiting guests cool during hot summer days, the park turns on an exterior waterfall that pours directly out of the main facade's eyes.
This coaster's title evokes a sinister peak shaped like the bony framework of a human head.

evidence.quote: Skull Mountain is an enclosed roller coaster located at Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson Township, New Jersey.
On hot summer days, the park turns on the ride's exterior waterfall, which falls from the exterior skull's eyes.
